$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this project config. Editors and tooling use it for autocomplete and validation.

anyOf.title: Item type
anyOf.description: The category of the registry item. Determines how the item is classified and which default install path it uses when resolving files.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Maps registry item types to install destinations. Use "*" as a catch-all for types without an explicit path. Paths may use aliases such as "~/components".

registries.title: Registries
registries.description: Registries registered with this project. Each entry selects a registry and may specify a repository source and install prefix.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The source repository that hosts the registry. Used to resolve and fetch registry contents when the registry is not already available locally.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: The registry to register with this project, in the form "owner/registry".

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: An optional install prefix used to namespace this registry's items and avoid collisions when multiple registries are registered in the same project.

items.title: Registered registry
items.description: A registry registered with the project. Identifies which registry to use and optionally where to fetch it from and under which prefix to install its items.

accent.title: Accent colors
accent.description: Accent (brand) color tokens for the project theme. Keys are token names and values are CSS color strings, typically in oklch.

neutral.title: Neutral colors
neutral.description: Neutral (gray-scale) color tokens for the project theme. Keys are token names and values are CSS color strings, typically in oklch.

cssVars.title: CSS variables
cssVars.description: Additional CSS custom properties for the project theme. Values are merged into UnoCSS preset options, nested as theme-key → variable-name → value.

unocss.title: UnoCSS extensions
unocss.description: Project-level UnoCSS theme extensions. Use this to customize accent colors, neutral colors, and additional CSS variables injected into the UnoCSS preset.

title: Project configuration
description: Configuration for a Weme UI project. Declares install paths, registered registries, and optional UnoCSS theme extensions.
